## History

Twenty-five years ago, Mr. Irving proposed to [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) under a honeysuckle trellis in the garden at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), but their engagement was later broken. Decades after their separation, [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md) reunited with [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and the two were married at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) in a ceremony attended by their friends. Later, Stephen's son [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) visited [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) during summer breaks alongside his stepmother [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P26](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0026), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P10](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0010), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P29](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0029), +7 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Irving is married to [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), whom he wed at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Their union was preceded by a past romance and a broken engagement, though they eventually reunited after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) introduced [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) to Irving's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md). [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) remains a welcoming presence who later offers advice to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) regarding her relationship with [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P4](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0004), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P10](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0010), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P15](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0015), +11 more_
